reasoning: This checkout implements a deployable vLLM-compatible inference simulator service. The Go main package starts the simulator and communication layer; the simulator processes inference requests; the communication package exposes HTTP and gRPC APIs, health endpoints, metrics, and model-serving operations. Docker and Kubernetes deployment manifests, plus an application-type Helm chart, package and deploy the long-running server. Although it contains reusable Go packages and configuration/manifests, its primary artifact and runtime role are a network service rather than a library, operator, or configuration-only component.
